name: VRM_PERF_OBLIGATION_LINES
description: This table contains the performance obligation lines of customer contract.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Running sequence number within a customer contract.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Customer contract header unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line unique identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document line unique identifier.

columns.name: LINE_SATISFACTION_STATUS
columns.description: Satisfaction status of the performance obligation line. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_LINE_SATISFACTN_STATUS.

columns.name: LINE_SATISFACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which a performance obligation line is satisfied.

columns.name: FIRST_SATISFACTION_EVENT_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the first satisfaction event is created for a promised detail line.

columns.name: PRICING_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Pricing combination identifier.

columns.name: FMV_LINE_ID
columns.description: Revenue price line unique identifier

columns.name: NET_LINE_AMT
columns.description: Net line amount.

columns.name: ENTERED_CUR_VAR_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: Variable consideration amount.

columns.name: ENTERED_CUR_NET_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: The sum of the net line amount and the variable consideration in the entered currency.

columns.name: ENTERED_CUR_CARVE_OUT_AMT
columns.description: Discount amount in the entered currency.

columns.name: ENTERED_CUR_ALLOCATED_AMT
columns.description: The sum of the net consideration amount and the discount amount in the entered currency.

columns.name: ENTERED_CUR_RECOG_REV_AMT
columns.description: Revenue recognized in the entered currency.

columns.name: ENTERED_CUR_BILLED_AMT
columns.description: Billed amount in the entered currency.

columns.name: ENTERED_CUR_FMV_AMT
columns.description: Revenue price amount in the entered currency.

columns.name: REV_REC_PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the revenue recognition of this performance obligation line was processed.

columns.name: MISSING_REV_INFORMATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if any revenue related attributes are missing on the performance obligation line for the satisfaction measurement events creation.

columns.name: REPROCESS_LINE_EVENTS_FLAG
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: REV_REC_REPROCESS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Revenue recognition reprocessing status. Values are from the lookup ORA_REV_REC_REPROCESS_STATUS.

columns.name: BILLING_LINE_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether zero amount billing line is created for the implied promise detail line upon full satisfaction.

columns.name: PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount paid by the customer against this performance obligation line.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_MEASUREMENT_MODEL
columns.description: Specifies how satisfaction will be measured and recorded for a performance obligation line. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SATIS_MEAS_MODEL.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_BASE_PROPORTION
columns.description:
Base number for the satisfaction schedule
proportions. The default value is 100. The base number is updated when the
schedule rows are updated and it will be sum of the numerator of the ratio of
all schedules.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a revenue scheduling rule.

columns.name: REVENUE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which revenue must be recognized.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_DURATION
columns.description: Number of periods in which revenue of this  performance obligation line is to be recognized.

columns.name: REVENUE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date until which revenue must be recognized.

columns.name: REV_REC_PROCESD_DOC_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document line unique identifier. Used for satisfaction events creation.

columns.name: REV_REC_PROCESD_REV_RULE_ID
columns.description: Revenue scheduling rule unique identifier. Used for satisfaction events creation.

columns.name: REV_REC_PROCESD_REV_START_DATE
columns.description: Revenue recognition start date that was most recently used for accounting events creation.

columns.name: REV_REC_PROCESD_REV_RULE_DUR
columns.description: Revenue recognition rule duration that was most recently used for accounting events creation.

columns.name: REV_REC_PROCESD_REV_END_DATE
columns.description: Revenue recognition end date that was most recently used for accounting events creation.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_NET_LINE_AMT
columns.description: Total line amount of all the performance obligation lines in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_VAR_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: Variable consideration amount in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_NET_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: Net consideration amount in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_CARVE_OUT_AMT
columns.description: Discount amount in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_ALLOCATED_AMT
columns.description: Allocated transaction price in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_RECOG_REV_AMT
columns.description: Revenue recognized in the contract Currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_BILLED_AMT
columns.description: Billed amount in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_FMV_AMT
columns.description: Revenue price amount in the contract currency.

columns.name: STANDALONE_SALES_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicates whether this obligation line will be used in selling price calculation.
The following are the eligible contracts for selling price calculation: 
Contracts with a single obligation and a single obligation line.
Contracts with a single obligation and multiple obligation lines.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_CONFIRM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this obligation line needs a satisfaction confirmation.

columns.name: AUTOMATIC_CONFIRMATION_PERIOD
columns.description: The number of days after the satisfaction measurement date of each satisfaction event on which the satisfaction measurement should be automatically confirmed by the system.

columns.name: LINE_SOURCE
columns.description: The source through which this line is created. Values are from the lookup  type ORA_LINE_SOURCE.

columns.name: LINE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the obligation line.

columns.name: BU_ID
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier of source document line.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: User entered comments.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate for converting amounts from the obligation currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Conversion date to be used to derive the conversion rate for converting amounts from the obligation currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: REMOVED_DATE
columns.description: Obligation line removed date.

columns.name: REMOVED_BY
columns.description: Obligation line removed by

columns.name: REMOVED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a given performance obligation line is removed from performance obligation.

columns.name: REMOVED_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that marked this row as removed.

columns.name: MOVE_TO_CONTR_NUMBER
columns.description: Target customer contract number.

columns.name: MOVE_TO_OBLIG_NUMBER
columns.description: Target performance obligation number.

columns.name: PARENT_PERF_OBLIG_LINE_ID
columns.description: Related line identifier for an implied performance obligation line.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: The process or user interface from which this row is created..

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SE_CREATED_FROM_SUBLINE_FLAG
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: DISCARD_FLAG
columns.description: Used to identify whether the obligation line is discarded or not.

columns.name: CONTRACT_UPDATE_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Revenue contract update template identifier.

columns.name: LATEST_REVISION_INTENT_CODE
columns.description: Revision intent of the last source document line version of the promised detail. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_REVISION_INTENT_TYPE.

columns.name: LATEST_VERSION_DATE
columns.description: Date of the most recent version of the promised detail line's supporting source document.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the promised detail line is eligible for allocation after processing the immaterial change.

columns.name: NET_QUANTITY
columns.description: Net quantity of a promised detail line.

columns.name: EFFECTIVITY_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a standard sales price effectivity period. Derived using the customer contract date.

columns.name: RESIDUAL_APPROACH_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the pricing for the goods or services for the promised detail line is variable or missing and the standalone selling price for the performance obligation is estimated using the residual approach. Valid values are from the lookup type VRM_YES/NO.

columns.name: PO_TEMPLATE_GROUPING_CODE
columns.description: Code value used to group lines with a similar non-amount band pricing dimension combination.

columns.name: SERVICE_UOM
columns.description: Unit of measure of the service item on the source document line. Valid values are from the Price Periodicity UOM Class defined in Oracle Fusion Pricing.

columns.name: SERVICE_DURATION
columns.description: Duration of the service item in terms of the service unit of measure.

columns.name: ABS_SSP_POL
columns.description: The absolute value of the unit standalone selling price for an item or service.

columns.name: POL_SSP_RANGE_RULE_CODE
columns.description: The rule that is applied to the promised detail in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_RULE.

columns.name: POL_SSP_RULE_RESULT_CODE
columns.description: The result of the rule that is applied to the promised detail in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_CODE.

columns.name: SSP_LOW
columns.description: The low point of the acceptable standalone selling price ranges. This value is used to determine the unit standalone selling price in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy for ranges.

columns.name: SSP_HIGH
columns.description: The high point of the acceptable standalone selling price ranges. This value is used to determine the unit standalone selling price in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy for ranges.

columns.name: REFERENCE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency used as the reference currency for converting entered currency amounts to the reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Rate type used to convert entered currency amounts to reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Date used for converting amounts from the entered currency to the reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Rate used for converting amounts from the entered currency to the reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_CURR_DATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Date type used to convert entered currency amounts to the reference currency, Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_REF_CONVERSION_RATE_DATE.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_CURRENCY_UNIT_SSP
columns.description: The unit standalone selling price in obligation currency.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_SE_EXISTENCE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the promised detail line has any additional satisfaction events on it. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_LINE_ASE_EXISTANCE.

columns.name: ASE_FULFILLMENT_PROCESS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether all the additional sublines indicating the fulfillment of additional satisfaction events for the promised detail line are processed or not. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_LINE_ASE_PROCESS

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_SE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The overall fulfillment status of all the additional satisfaction events on the promised detail line. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_LINE_SATISFACTN_STATUS.

columns.name: ASE_ELIGIBLE_REVENUE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount that is equivalent to the fulfillment of all of the additional satisfaction events.

columns.name: PSE_ELIGIBLE_REVENUE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount that is equivalent to the fulfillment of all the primary satisfaction events.

columns.name: ASE_PENDING_REVENUE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount that is pending to be recognized as revenue, even though the additional satisfaction event is fulfilled.

columns.name: PSE_PENDING_REVENUE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount that is pending to be recognized as revenue, even though the primary satisfaction event is fulfilled.

columns.name: SE_RECOGNIZED_REVENUE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of revenue recognized upon fulfillment of both the primary and additional satisfaction events.

columns.name: LAST_PSE_DATE
columns.description: Last fulfillment date of the primary satisfaction event.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_ASE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the fulfillment of the additional satisfaction event according to the satisfaction measurement model. The value indicates the satisfied quantity, satisfied percent, or period equivalent amount.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_PSE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the fulfillment of the primary satisfaction event according to the satisfaction measurement model. The value indicates the satisfied quantity, satisfied percent, or period equivalent amount.

columns.name: RECOGNIZED_SE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the fulfillment of both the primary and additional satisfaction events according to the satisfaction measurement model. The value indicates the satisfied quantity, satisfied percent, or period equivalent amount.

columns.name: PENDING_ASE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the fulfillment of the additional satisfaction event that is pending revenue recognition according to the satisfaction measurement model. The value is either the satisfied quantity, satisfied percent, or period equivalent amount.

columns.name: PENDING_PSE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the fulfillment of the primary satisfaction event that is pending revenue recognition according to the satisfaction measurement model. The value is either the satisfied quantity, satisfied percent, or period equivalent amount.
